description: What the caller may see of a node in a table lineage graph.

enum.name: READABLE
enum.description: The caller can read the object: its name, type and state are included, and the lineage continues through it.

enum.name: RESTRICTED
enum.description: The caller cannot read the object: only its id is included, and the lineage does not continue past it.

enum.name: NOT_FOUND
enum.description: The object no longer exists (or is in the trash can), but a dependency on it is still recorded.
